event_name: Date 28 April 2019 Time 16:54 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 88 left the team's designated garage when not permitted to do so.
offence: Breach of Article 28.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 88, which was required to start the race from the pit lane, drove from the team's designated garage area earlier than 20 minutes before the scheduled start of the formation lap, in breach of Article 28.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
